# backend/generate_audio.py
import os
from pathlib import Path
from gtts import gTTS
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from app.models.lesson import Lesson

load_dotenv()
engine = create_engine(os.getenv("DATABASE_URL"))
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
db = Session()

# РџР°РїРєР° РґР»СЏ Р°СѓРґРёРѕС„Р°Р№Р»РѕРІ
AUDIO_DIR = Path(__file__).parent / "static/audio"
AUDIO_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# РќР°С…РѕРґРёРј СѓСЂРѕРєРё СЃ РїРёР»Р»Р°СЂРѕРј listening РёР»Рё pronunciation
lessons = db.query(Lesson).filter(
    Lesson.pillar.in_(["listening", "pronunciation"])
).all()

print(f"рџ”Љ Р“РµРЅРµСЂР°С†РёСЏ Р°СѓРґРёРѕ РґР»СЏ {len(lessons)} СѓСЂРѕРєРѕРІ...")

for lesson in lessons:
    # Р‘РµСЂС‘Рј РїРµСЂРІРѕРµ РїСЂРµРґР»РѕР¶РµРЅРёРµ РёР· РїСЂРёРјРµСЂРѕРІ РёР»Рё РїСЂР°РІРёР»Р°
    text = lesson.content.get("examples", [""])[0]
    if not text:
        text = lesson.content.get("rule", "")

    # РЎРѕР·РґР°С‘Рј РёРјСЏ С„Р°Р№Р»Р°
    filename = f"lesson_{lesson.id}.mp3"
    filepath = AUDIO_DIR / filename

    # Р“РµРЅРµСЂРёСЂСѓРµРј Р°СѓРґРёРѕ
    try:
        tts = gTTS(text=text, lang='de')
        tts.save(str(filepath))
        print(f"вњ… {lesson.topic}: {filename}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"вќЊ РћС€РёР±РєР° РґР»СЏ {lesson.topic}: {e}")

print("рџЋµ Р“РѕС‚РѕРІРѕ!")

# ==========================================

for lesson in lessons_data:
    existing = db.query(Lesson).filter(Lesson.topic == lesson["topic"]).first()
    if not existing:
        db.add(Lesson(**lesson))
        print(f"вћ• Р”РѕР±Р°РІР»РµРЅ СѓСЂРѕРє: {lesson['topic']} ({lesson['level']})")
    else:
        print(f"вЏ© РЈСЂРѕРє '{lesson['topic']}' СѓР¶Рµ СЃСѓС‰РµСЃС‚РІСѓРµС‚, РїСЂРѕРїСѓСЃРє.")

db.commit()
print(f"\nвњ… Р”РѕР±Р°РІР»РµРЅРѕ {len(lessons_data)} СѓСЂРѕРєРѕРІ!")

print("рџ“љ Р”РѕР±Р°РІР»РµРЅРёРµ СѓСЂРѕРєРѕРІ...")
count = 0
for lesson in lessons_data:
    existing = db.query(Lesson).filter(Lesson.topic == lesson["topic"]).first()
    if not existing:
        db.add(Lesson(**lesson))
        count += 1
        print(f"вћ• Р”РѕР±Р°РІР»РµРЅ: {lesson['topic']} ({lesson['level']})")
    else:
        print(f"вЏ© РЈСЂРѕРє '{lesson['topic']}' СѓР¶Рµ СЃСѓС‰РµСЃС‚РІСѓРµС‚.")

db.commit()
print(f"\nвњ… Р”РѕР±Р°РІР»РµРЅРѕ {count} РЅРѕРІС‹С… СѓСЂРѕРєРѕРІ. Р’СЃРµРіРѕ РІ Р‘Р”: {db.query(Lesson).count()} СѓСЂРѕРєРѕРІ.")

# backend/app/main.py
from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
from app.api.endpoints import diagnostic, dashboard, plan, tutor, lesson, badges, mistakes, stats, referral
import os

app = FastAPI(title="DeutschIQ API")

# CORS
app.add_middleware(
    CORSMiddleware,
    allow_origins=["*"],
    allow_credentials=True,
    allow_methods=["*"],
    allow_headers=["*"],
)

app.include_router(diagnostic.router)
app.include_router(dashboard.router)
app.include_router(plan.router)
app.include_router(tutor.router)
app.include_router(lesson.router)
app.include_router(badges.router)
app.include_router(mistakes.router)
app.include_router(stats.router)
app.include_router(referral.router)

frontend_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "../../frontend/mini-app/dist")

if os.path.exists(frontend_path):
    assets_path = os.path.join(frontend_path, "assets")
    if os.path.exists(assets_path):
        app.mount("/assets", StaticFiles(directory=assets_path), name="assets")
    
    @app.get("/{full_path:path}")
    async def serve_frontend(full_path: str):
        if full_path.startswith("api/"):
            return {"error": "API endpoint not found"}
        file_path = os.path.join(frontend_path, full_path)
        if os.path.exists(file_path) and os.path.isfile(file_path):
            response = FileResponse(file_path)
            response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"
            response.headers["Pragma"] = "no-cache"
            response.headers["Expires"] = "0"
            return response
        response = FileResponse(os.path.join(frontend_path, "index.html"))
        response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"
        response.headers["Pragma"] = "no-cache"
        response.headers["Expires"] = "0"
        return response
else:
    print(f"вљ пёЏ Frontend not found at {frontend_path}. Run 'npm run build' first.")

@app.get("/")
async def root():
    if os.path.exists(frontend_path):
        response = FileResponse(os.path.join(frontend_path, "index.html"))
        response.headers["Cache-Control"] = "no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate"
        response.headers["Pragma"] = "no-cache"
        response.headers["Expires"] = "0"
        return response
    return {"status": "DeutschIQ API СЂР°Р±РѕС‚Р°РµС‚"}

@router.get("/{user_id}")
async def get_badges(user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.telegram_id == user_id).first()
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="РџРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЊ РЅРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅ")
    
    badges = db.query(UserBadge).filter(UserBadge.user_id == user.id).all()
    return [
        {"badge_type": b.badge_type, "badge_name": b.badge_name, "badge_icon": b.badge_icon, "earned_at": b.earned_at}
        for b in badges
    ]

# backend/app/api/endpoints/dashboard.py
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.core.database import get_db
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.diagnostic import DiagnosticResult

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/dashboard", tags=["dashboard"])

@router.get("/{user_id}")
async def get_dashboard(user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.telegram_id == user_id).first()
    if not user:
        return {"error": "User not found"}
    
    diag = db.query(DiagnosticResult).filter(DiagnosticResult.user_id == user.id).order_by(DiagnosticResult.created_at.desc()).first()
    if not diag:
        # Р—Р°РіР»СѓС€РєР°, РµСЃР»Рё РґРёР°РіРЅРѕСЃС‚РёРєР° РЅРµ РїСЂРѕР№РґРµРЅР°
        return {
            "level": "A1",
            "percentage": 0,
            "targetLevel": "B2",
            "targetProgress": 0,
            "stats": [
                {"label": "Grammatik", "value": 0, "trend": "up"},
                {"label": "Aussprache", "value": 0, "trend": "up"},
                {"label": "Wortschatz", "value": 0, "trend": "down"},
                {"label": "HГ¶rverstehen", "value": 0, "trend": "up"},
            ],
            "weaknesses": []
        }
    
    return {
        "level": user.current_level + "+",
        "percentage": diag.overall_score,
        "targetLevel": user.target_level,
        "targetProgress": min(diag.overall_score, 100),
        "stats": [
            {"label": "Grammatik", "value": diag.grammar_score, "trend": "up" if diag.grammar_score > 5 else "down"},
            {"label": "Aussprache", "value": diag.pronunciation_score, "trend": "up" if diag.pronunciation_score > 5 else "down"},
            {"label": "Wortschatz", "value": diag.vocabulary_score, "trend": "up" if diag.vocabulary_score > 5 else "down"},
            {"label": "HГ¶rverstehen", "value": diag.listening_score, "trend": "up" if diag.listening_score > 5 else "down"},
        ],
        "weaknesses": [{"name": k, "percent": v * 10} for k, v in diag.weak_points.items()][:3] if diag.weak_points else []
    }

class SubmitAnswers(BaseModel):
    user_id: int
    answers: Dict[int, str]

@router.get("/questions")
async def get_questions(lang: str = "ru"):
    return MOCK_QUESTIONS

@router.post("/submit")
async def submit_diagnostic(data: SubmitAnswers, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    result = calculate_level_and_scores(data.answers, MOCK_QUESTIONS)
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.telegram_id == data.user_id).first()
    if not user:
        user = User(telegram_id=data.user_id)
        db.add(user)
        db.flush()
    diag = DiagnosticResult(
        user_id=user.id,
        overall_score=result["overall_score"],
        grammar_score=result["pillars"]["grammar"],
        vocabulary_score=result["pillars"]["vocabulary"],
        listening_score=result["pillars"]["listening"],
        pronunciation_score=result["pillars"]["pronunciation"],
        weak_points=result["weak_points"]
    )
    db.add(diag)
    db.commit()
    if user.current_level != result["level"]:
        user.current_level = result["level"]
        db.commit()
    return {
        "level": result["level"],
        "overall_score": result["overall_score"],
        "pillars": result["pillars"],
        "weak_points": result["weak_points"],
        "weak_tags": list(result["weak_points"].keys())
    }

# backend/app/api/endpoints/lesson.py
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException

# Р“РµРЅРµСЂР°С†РёСЏ СѓРїСЂР°Р¶РЅРµРЅРёР№ (Р·Р°РїР°СЃРЅС‹Рµ)
class GenerateExercisesRequest(BaseModel):

@router.post("/generate-exercises")
async def generate_exercises(data: GenerateExercisesRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):

    diag = db.query(DiagnosticResult).filter(
        DiagnosticResult.user_id == user.id

    if not lesson:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="РЈСЂРѕРє РЅРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅ")
    
    return {

            {"type": "fill", "question": f"Р’СЃС‚Р°РІСЊС‚Рµ РїСЂРѕРїСѓС‰РµРЅРЅРѕРµ СЃР»РѕРІРѕ: Ich ___ einen Hund.", "answer": "habe", "hint": "РіР»Р°РіРѕР» haben"},
            {"type": "choose", "question": "___ Auto ist neu.", "options": ["Der", "Die", "Das", "Den"], "answer": "Das", "hint": "СЃСЂРµРґРЅРёР№ СЂРѕРґ"},
            {"type": "translate", "question": "РџРµСЂРµРІРµРґРёС‚Рµ: 'РЇ РёРґСѓ РґРѕРјРѕР№.'", "answer": "Ich gehe nach Hause.", "hint": "РіР»Р°РіРѕР» gehen"}
        ]
    }

# Р—Р°РІРµСЂС€РёС‚СЊ СѓСЂРѕРє (РќРћР’Р«Р™ Р­РќР”РџРћРРќРў)
class CompleteLessonRequest(BaseModel):
    user_id: int
    lesson_id: int

@router.post("/complete")
async def complete_lesson(data: CompleteLessonRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.telegram_id == data.user_id).first()
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="РџРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЊ РЅРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅ")
    
    lesson = db.query(Lesson).filter(Lesson.id == data.lesson_id).first()
    if not lesson:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="РЈСЂРѕРє РЅРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅ")
    
    # РџСЂРѕРІРµСЂСЏРµРј, РµСЃС‚СЊ Р»Рё СѓР¶Рµ Р·Р°РїРёСЃСЊ РїСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃСЃР°
    progress = db.query(UserProgress).filter(
        UserProgress.user_id == user.id,
        UserProgress.lesson_id == data.lesson_id
    ).first()
    
    if not progress:
        progress = UserProgress(
            user_id=user.id,
            lesson_id=data.lesson_id,
            completed=True,
            completed_at=datetime.now(),
            score=100
        )
        db.add(progress)
    else:
        progress.completed = True
        progress.completed_at = datetime.now()
    
    # Р”РѕР±Р°РІР»СЏРµРј XP РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЋ (РЅР°РїСЂРёРјРµСЂ, 50 XP Р·Р° СѓСЂРѕРє)
    user.xp = (user.xp or 0) + lesson.xp_reward
    db.commit()
    
    return {"status": "ok", "xp_gained": lesson.xp_reward}

@router.get("/{user_id}")
async def get_mistakes(user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.telegram_id == user_id).first()
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="User not found")
    
    diag = db.query(DiagnosticResult).filter(
        DiagnosticResult.user_id == user.id
    ).order_by(DiagnosticResult.created_at.desc()).first()
    
    if not diag or not diag.weak_points:
        return {"mistakes": []}
    
    mistakes = []
    for topic, count in diag.weak_points.items():
        example = EXAMPLE_MISTAKES.get(topic)
        if example:
            mistakes.append({
                "topic": topic,
                "count": count,
                "user_answer": example["user_answer"],
                "correct_answer": example["correct_answer"],
                "example_sentence": example["example_sentence"],
            })
        # Р•СЃР»Рё РЅРµС‚ РїСЂРёРјРµСЂР° вЂ” РїСЂРѕРїСѓСЃРєР°РµРј (РЅРµ РїРѕРєР°Р·С‹РІР°РµРј ???)
    
    # РЎРѕСЂС‚РёСЂСѓРµРј РїРѕ РєРѕР»РёС‡РµСЃС‚РІСѓ РѕС€РёР±РѕРє (РїРѕ СѓР±С‹РІР°РЅРёСЋ)
    mistakes.sort(key=lambda x: x["count"], reverse=True)
    
    return {"mistakes": mistakes[:5]}  # РўРѕРї-5 РѕС€РёР±РѕРє

async def get_plan(user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    try:
        user = db.query(User).filter(User.telegram_id == user_id).first()
        if not user:
            return {"error": f"РџРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЊ СЃ telegram_id {user_id} РЅРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅ"}

        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(e))

# backend/app/api/endpoints/referral.py
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.core.database import get_db
from app.models.user import User
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/referral", tags=["referral"])

@router.post("/create")
async def create_referral(user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.telegram_id == user_id).first()
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="User not found")
    
    referral_link = f"https://t.me/DeutschIQ_bot?start=ref_{user_id}"
    return {"link": referral_link}

@router.post("/claim")
async def claim_referral(referrer_id: int, referee_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    referrer = db.query(User).filter(User.telegram_id == referrer_id).first()
    if not referrer:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Referrer not found")
    
    from app.models.diagnostic import DiagnosticResult
    referee_test = db.query(DiagnosticResult).filter(
        DiagnosticResult.user_id == referee_id
    ).first()
    if not referee_test:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Referee hasn't completed test")
    
    if referrer.subscription_status == 'pro':
        referrer.subscription_end_date = (referrer.subscription_end_date or datetime.now()) + timedelta(days=3)
    else:
        referrer.subscription_status = 'pro'
        referrer.subscription_end_date = datetime.now() + timedelta(days=3)
    
    db.commit()
    return {"status": "bonus_added", "bonus_days": 3}

# backend/app/api/endpoints/stats.py
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.core.database import get_db
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.progress import UserProgress

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/stats", tags=["stats"])

@router.get("/{user_id}")
async def get_user_stats(user_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.telegram_id == user_id).first()
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="User not found")
    
    lessons_completed = db.query(UserProgress).filter(
        UserProgress.user_id == user.id,
        UserProgress.completed == True
    ).count()
    
    level_order = ['A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2', 'C1']
    current_level = user.current_level or 'A1'
    try:
        next_level = level_order[level_order.index(current_level) + 1]
    except (ValueError, IndexError):
        next_level = 'C1'
    
    xp_needed = 500 - (user.xp % 500) if user.xp % 500 != 0 else 0
    
    locked_badges = [
        {'name': 'РќРµРґРµР»СЏ СѓСЃРёР»РёР№', 'icon': 'рџ”Ґ', 'requirement': '7 РґРЅРµР№ РїРѕРґСЂСЏРґ'},
        {'name': 'РЈСЂРѕРІРµРЅСЊ B1', 'icon': 'рџЏ†', 'requirement': 'Р”РѕСЃС‚РёРіРЅСѓС‚СЊ СѓСЂРѕРІРЅСЏ B1'},
        {'name': '50 СѓСЂРѕРєРѕРІ', 'icon': 'рџЋ“', 'requirement': 'РџСЂРѕР№С‚Рё 50 СѓСЂРѕРєРѕРІ'},
        {'name': 'РњРµСЃСЏС† СѓСЃРµСЂРґРёСЏ', 'icon': 'в­ђ', 'requirement': '30 РґРЅРµР№ РїРѕРґСЂСЏРґ'},
    ]
    
    return {
        'level': current_level,
        'next_level': next_level,
        'xp': user.xp or 0,
        'xp_needed': xp_needed,
        'streak': user.streak or 0,
        'lessons_completed': lessons_completed,
        'total_lessons': 50,
        'subscription_status': user.subscription_status,
        'locked_badges': locked_badges,
    }

# backend/app/api/endpoints/tutor.py
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import List, Optional
from app.core.database import get_db
from app.models.user import User
from openai import OpenAI
from app.core.config import settings

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/tutor", tags=["tutor"])

# РРЅРёС†РёР°Р»РёР·Р°С†РёСЏ OpenAI
client = None
if settings.OPENAI_API_KEY:
    try:
        client = OpenAI(api_key=settings.OPENAI_API_KEY)
        print("вњ… OpenAI client initialized")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"вќЊ OpenAI init error: {e}")

class TutorRequest(BaseModel):
    user_id: int
    question: str
    history: Optional[List[dict]] = None   # <-- РќРћР’РћР• РџРћР›Р•

@router.post("/ask")
async def ask_tutor(data: TutorRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):
    # 1. РќР°Р№С‚Рё РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЏ
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.telegram_id == data.user_id).first()
    if not user:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="РџРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЊ РЅРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅ")
    
    # 2. Р•СЃР»Рё РЅРµС‚ OpenAI РєР»СЋС‡Р° вЂ“ РІРµСЂРЅСѓС‚СЊ Р·Р°РіР»СѓС€РєСѓ
    if not client:
        return {
            "answer": "рџ”‘ OpenAI API РєР»СЋС‡ РЅРµ РЅР°СЃС‚СЂРѕРµРЅ. Р”РѕР±Р°РІСЊС‚Рµ OPENAI_API_KEY РІ .env."
        }
    
    # 3. РџРѕР»СѓС‡РёС‚СЊ СѓСЂРѕРІРµРЅСЊ Рё СЏР·С‹Рє РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЏ
    level = user.current_level or "A1"
    lang = user.language_code or "ru"
    
    # 4. РЎРёСЃС‚РµРјРЅС‹Р№ РїСЂРѕРјРїС‚
    system_prompt = f"""
You are DeutschIQ Tutor, a C2-level German teacher.
User level: {level}
Respond in: {lang}

Rules:
- Explain grammar simply (max 3 sentences), give 2 examples
- For vocabulary: give translation + 2 example sentences
- Always correct mistakes politely
- If unsure, say "I'm not sure, let me check"
- Be encouraging and use emojis occasionally
- Keep answers under 200 words
"""
    
    # 5. РЎРѕР±РёСЂР°РµРј СЃРѕРѕР±С‰РµРЅРёСЏ: СЃРёСЃС‚РµРјРЅС‹Р№ РїСЂРѕРјРїС‚ + РёСЃС‚РѕСЂРёСЏ (РµСЃР»Рё РµСЃС‚СЊ) + С‚РµРєСѓС‰РёР№ РІРѕРїСЂРѕСЃ
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system_prompt}]
    if data.history:
        # РСЃС‚РѕСЂРёСЏ СѓР¶Рµ РёРјРµРµС‚ С„РѕСЂРјР°С‚ [{"role": "user", "content": "..."}, {"role": "assistant", "content": "..."}]
        messages.extend(data.history)
    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": data.question})
    
    # 6. Р—Р°РїСЂРѕСЃ Рє OpenAI
    try:
        response = client.chat.completions.create(
            model=settings.OPENAI_MODEL or "gpt-4o-mini",
            messages=messages,
            temperature=0.7,
            max_tokens=400
        )
        answer = response.choices[0].message.content
        return {"answer": answer}
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"вќЊ OpenAI error: {e}")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=f"РћС€РёР±РєР° AI: {str(e)}")

# backend/app/bot/main.py
import asyncio
import logging
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from aiogram import Bot, Dispatcher, types
from aiogram.filters import Command
from aiogram.types import WebAppInfo, InlineKeyboardButton, InlineKeyboardMarkup, LabeledPrice, PreCheckoutQuery, Message
from app.core.config import settings
from app.models.user import User
from app.core.database import SessionLocal

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
bot = Bot(token=settings.BOT_TOKEN)
dp = Dispatcher()

# ==========================================
# РҐР•РќР”Р›Р•Р Р«
# ==========================================

@dp.message(Command("start"))
async def cmd_start(message: Message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    web_app_url = f"{settings.WEBAPP_URL}?user_id={user_id}"
    db = SessionLocal()
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.telegram_id == user_id).first()
    if not user:
        user = User(telegram_id=user_id)
        db.add(user)
        db.commit()
    db.close()
    keyboard = InlineKeyboardMarkup(inline_keyboard=[
        [InlineKeyboardButton(text="рџ‡©рџ‡Є РћС‚РєСЂС‹С‚СЊ DeutschIQ", web_app=WebAppInfo(url=web_app_url))]
    ])
    await message.answer(
        "рџ‡©рџ‡Є Р”РѕР±СЂРѕ РїРѕР¶Р°Р»РѕРІР°С‚СЊ РІ DeutschIQ!\n\n"
        "РџСЂРѕР№РґРё РґРёР°РіРЅРѕСЃС‚РёРєСѓ Рё РїРѕР»СѓС‡Рё РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ РїР»Р°РЅ РёР·СѓС‡РµРЅРёСЏ РЅРµРјРµС†РєРѕРіРѕ.\n"
        "РќР°Р¶РјРё РЅР° РєРЅРѕРїРєСѓ РЅРёР¶Рµ, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РЅР°С‡Р°С‚СЊ.",
        reply_markup=keyboard
    )

@dp.message(Command("subscribe"))
async def cmd_subscribe(message: Message):
    prices = [LabeledPrice(label="1 РјРµСЃСЏС† Pro-РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїР°", amount=700)]
    await message.answer_invoice(
        title="DeutschIQ Pro",
        description="РџРѕР»РЅС‹Р№ РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРї Рє РґРёР°РіРЅРѕСЃС‚РёРєРµ, РїР»Р°РЅСѓ, AI-С‚СЊСЋС‚РѕСЂСѓ Рё РІСЃРµРј СѓСЂРѕРєР°Рј",
        payload=f"sub_{message.from_user.id}_monthly",
        provider_token="",
        currency="XTR",
        prices=prices,
        start_parameter="deutschiq_sub"
    )

@dp.pre_checkout_query()
async def pre_checkout(query: PreCheckoutQuery):
    await query.answer(ok=True)

@dp.message(lambda m: m.successful_payment is not None)
async def successful_payment(message: Message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    db = SessionLocal()
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.telegram_id == user_id).first()
    if user:
        user.subscription_status = "pro"
        user.subscription_end_date = datetime.now() + timedelta(days=30)
        db.commit()
    db.close()
    await message.answer(
        "вњ… РћРїР»Р°С‚Р° СѓСЃРїРµС€РЅР°! Р’Р°С€ Pro-РїР»Р°РЅ Р°РєС‚РёРІРµРЅ.\n"
        "Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°Р№С‚РµСЃСЊ РІ Mini App, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РЅР°С‡Р°С‚СЊ СѓСЂРѕРєРё."
    )

@dp.message(lambda m: m.web_app_data is not None)
async def handle_web_app_data(message: Message):
    data = message.web_app_data.data
    if data and 'command' in data and data['command'] == '/subscribe':
        await cmd_subscribe(message)

# ==========================================
# Р—РђРџРЈРЎРљ
# ==========================================

async def main():
    await bot.delete_webhook(drop_pending_updates=True)
    print("рџљЂ Р‘РѕС‚ Р·Р°РїСѓС‰РµРЅ Рё РіРѕС‚РѕРІ РїСЂРёРЅРёРјР°С‚СЊ РєРѕРјР°РЅРґС‹")
    await dp.start_polling(bot)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

# backend/app/bot/scheduler.py
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime, time, timedelta
from aiogram import Bot
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.core.database import SessionLocal
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.progress import UserProgress

async def send_daily_reminders(bot: Bot):
    db = SessionLocal()
    today = datetime.now().date()
    
    users = db.query(User).filter(
        User.last_activity < datetime.now() - timedelta(days=1)
    ).all()
    
    sent = 0
    for user in users:
        try:
            await bot.send_message(
                user.telegram_id,
                "рџ‡©рџ‡Є Р”РѕР±СЂРѕРµ СѓС‚СЂРѕ! рџЊ…\n\n"
                "РќРµ Р·Р°Р±СѓРґСЊ РїСЂРѕР№С‚Рё СЃРµРіРѕРґРЅСЏС€РЅРёР№ СѓСЂРѕРє РІ DeutschIQ!\n"
                "РљР°Р¶РґС‹Р№ РґРµРЅСЊ РїСЂРёР±Р»РёР¶Р°РµС‚ С‚РµР±СЏ Рє С†РµР»Рё рџЋЇ\n\n"
                "рџ‘‰ РћС‚РєСЂРѕР№ Р±РѕС‚Р° Рё РЅР°Р¶РјРё 'РћС‚РєСЂС‹С‚СЊ DeutschIQ'"
            )
            sent += 1
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
        except:
            pass
    
    db.close()
    print(f"рџ“Ё РћС‚РїСЂР°РІР»РµРЅРѕ {sent} РЅР°РїРѕРјРёРЅР°РЅРёР№")

async def schedule_daily_reminders(bot: Bot):
    while True:
        now = datetime.now()
        target = datetime.combine(now.date(), time(10, 0))
        if now > target:
            target += timedelta(days=1)
        wait_time = (target - now).total_seconds()
        print(f"вЏі РЎР»РµРґСѓСЋС‰РµРµ РЅР°РїРѕРјРёРЅР°РЅРёРµ С‡РµСЂРµР· {wait_time/3600:.1f} С‡Р°СЃРѕРІ")
        await asyncio.sleep(wait_time)
        await send_daily_reminders(bot)

def get_db():
    db = SessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.progress import UserProgress
from app.models.badge import UserBadge

BADGE_CONFIG = {
    'first_lesson': {'name': 'РџРµСЂРІС‹Р№ СѓСЂРѕРє', 'icon': 'рџЋЇ', 'condition': 'lessons_completed >= 1'},
    'week_streak': {'name': 'РќРµРґРµР»СЏ СѓСЃРёР»РёР№', 'icon': 'рџ”Ґ', 'condition': 'streak >= 7'},
    'month_streak': {'name': 'РњРµСЃСЏС† СѓСЃРµСЂРґРёСЏ', 'icon': 'в­ђ', 'condition': 'streak >= 30'},
    'level_b1': {'name': 'РЈСЂРѕРІРµРЅСЊ B1', 'icon': 'рџЏ†', 'condition': 'level == "B1"'},
    'level_b2': {'name': 'РЈСЂРѕРІРµРЅСЊ B2', 'icon': 'рџ‘‘', 'condition': 'level == "B2"'},
    'level_c1': {'name': 'РЈСЂРѕРІРµРЅСЊ C1', 'icon': 'рџ’Ћ', 'condition': 'level == "C1"'},
    'perfect_test': {'name': 'РРґРµР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Р№ С‚РµСЃС‚', 'icon': 'рџ’Ї', 'condition': 'test_score == 100'},
    'daily_streak_3': {'name': '3 РґРЅСЏ РїРѕРґСЂСЏРґ', 'icon': 'рџ“…', 'condition': 'streak >= 3'},
    'daily_streak_10': {'name': '10 РґРЅРµР№ РїРѕРґСЂСЏРґ', 'icon': 'рџ”Ґ', 'condition': 'streak >= 10'},
    'daily_streak_30': {'name': '30 РґРЅРµР№ РїРѕРґСЂСЏРґ', 'icon': 'рџ‘‘', 'condition': 'streak >= 30'},
    'lessons_10': {'name': '10 СѓСЂРѕРєРѕРІ', 'icon': 'рџ“љ', 'condition': 'lessons_completed >= 10'},
    'lessons_50': {'name': '50 СѓСЂРѕРєРѕРІ', 'icon': 'рџЋ“', 'condition': 'lessons_completed >= 50'},
    'lessons_100': {'name': '100 СѓСЂРѕРєРѕРІ', 'icon': 'рџЏ…', 'condition': 'lessons_completed >= 100'},
}

def check_and_award_badges(db: Session, user_id: int):
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id).first()
    if not user:
        return []
    
    lessons_completed = db.query(UserProgress).filter(
        UserProgress.user_id == user_id,
        UserProgress.completed == True
    ).count()
    
    # РџРѕР»СѓС‡Р°РµРј РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅРёР№ СЂРµР·СѓР»СЊС‚Р°С‚ С‚РµСЃС‚Р° (РµСЃР»Рё РµСЃС‚СЊ)
    from app.models.diagnostic import DiagnosticResult
    last_test = db.query(DiagnosticResult).filter(
        DiagnosticResult.user_id == user_id
    ).order_by(DiagnosticResult.created_at.desc()).first()
    test_score = last_test.overall_score if last_test else 0
    
    awarded = []
    existing = [b.badge_type for b in db.query(UserBadge).filter(UserBadge.user_id == user_id).all()]
    
    checks = {
        'first_lesson': lessons_completed >= 1,
        'week_streak': user.streak >= 7,
        'month_streak': user.streak >= 30,
        'level_b1': user.current_level == 'B1',
        'level_b2': user.current_level == 'B2',
        'level_c1': user.current_level == 'C1',
        'perfect_test': test_score >= 100,
        'daily_streak_3': user.streak >= 3,
        'daily_streak_10': user.streak >= 10,
        'daily_streak_30': user.streak >= 30,
        'lessons_10': lessons_completed >= 10,
        'lessons_50': lessons_completed >= 50,
        'lessons_100': lessons_completed >= 100,
    }
    
    for badge_type, condition in checks.items():
        if badge_type in existing:
            continue
        if condition:
            badge = UserBadge(
                user_id=user_id,
                badge_type=badge_type,
                badge_name=BADGE_CONFIG[badge_type]['name'],
                badge_icon=BADGE_CONFIG[badge_type]['icon']
            )
            db.add(badge)
            awarded.append(BADGE_CONFIG[badge_type])
    
    if awarded:
        db.commit()
    
    return awarded

# backend/app/services/diagnostic.py
from typing import Dict, List

LEVEL_THRESHOLDS = {'A1': 0.4, 'A2': 0.55, 'B1': 0.7, 'B2': 0.85, 'C1': 0.95}

def calculate_level_and_scores(answers: Dict[int, str], questions: List[dict]) -> dict:
    total = len(answers)
    correct = 0
    pillar_correct = {'grammar': 0, 'vocabulary': 0, 'listening': 0, 'pronunciation': 0}
    pillar_total = {'grammar': 0, 'vocabulary': 0, 'listening': 0, 'pronunciation': 0}
    weak_points = {}

    for q in questions:
        q_id = q['id']
        pillar = q.get('pillar', 'grammar')
        pillar_total[pillar] += 1
        if answers.get(q_id) == q['correct_answer']:
            correct += 1
            pillar_correct[pillar] += 1
        else:
            for tag in q.get('weak_tags', []):
                weak_points[tag] = weak_points.get(tag, 0) + 1

    overall_pct = (correct / total) * 100 if total > 0 else 0
    level = 'A1'
    for lvl, threshold in LEVEL_THRESHOLDS.items():
        if overall_pct / 100 >= threshold:
            level = lvl

    pillar_scores = {}
    for p in pillar_total:
        t = pillar_total[p]
        pillar_scores[p] = round((pillar_correct[p] / t) * 10, 1) if t > 0 else 0

    return {
        "level": level,
        "overall_score": round(overall_pct, 1),
        "pillars": pillar_scores,
        "weak_points": weak_points
    }

# backend/app/services/exercise_generator.py
import openai
import json
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.core.config import settings
from app.models.user import User
from app.models.diagnostic import DiagnosticResult
from app.models.lesson import Lesson

openai.api_key = settings.OPENAI_API_KEY

def generate_exercises(db: Session, user_id: int, lesson_id: int) -> list:
    """
    Р“РµРЅРµСЂРёСЂСѓРµС‚ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р»РёР·РёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ СѓРїСЂР°Р¶РЅРµРЅРёСЏ РґР»СЏ РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЏ РЅР° РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРµ СѓСЂРѕРєР° Рё РµРіРѕ СЃР»Р°Р±РѕСЃС‚РµР№.
    Р’РѕР·РІСЂР°С‰Р°РµС‚ СЃРїРёСЃРѕРє СѓРїСЂР°Р¶РЅРµРЅРёР№ РІ С„РѕСЂРјР°С‚Рµ JSON.
    """
    # 1. РџРѕР»СѓС‡Р°РµРј РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЏ Рё РµРіРѕ СЃР»Р°Р±РѕСЃС‚Рё
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id).first()
    if not user:
        raise ValueError("РџРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЊ РЅРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅ")
    
    # Р‘РµСЂС‘Рј РїРѕСЃР»РµРґРЅСЋСЋ РґРёР°РіРЅРѕСЃС‚РёРєСѓ
    diag = db.query(DiagnosticResult).filter(
        DiagnosticResult.user_id == user_id
    ).order_by(DiagnosticResult.created_at.desc()).first()
    
    weak_tags = list(diag.weak_points.keys()) if diag and diag.weak_points else []
    
    # 2. РџРѕР»СѓС‡Р°РµРј СѓСЂРѕРє
    lesson = db.query(Lesson).filter(Lesson.id == lesson_id).first()
    if not lesson:
        raise ValueError("РЈСЂРѕРє РЅРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅ")
    
    # 3. Р¤РѕСЂРјРёСЂСѓРµРј РїСЂРѕРјРїС‚ РґР»СЏ OpenAI
    prompt = f"""
РўС‹ вЂ” СЌРєСЃРїРµСЂС‚ РїРѕ РЅРµРјРµС†РєРѕРјСѓ СЏР·С‹РєСѓ. РЎРѕР·РґР°Р№ 3 СѓРїСЂР°Р¶РЅРµРЅРёСЏ РґР»СЏ СѓС‡РµРЅРёРєР° СѓСЂРѕРІРЅСЏ {user.current_level} РїРѕ С‚РµРјРµ "{lesson.topic}".

РЎР»Р°Р±С‹Рµ РјРµСЃС‚Р° СѓС‡РµРЅРёРєР°: {', '.join(weak_tags) if weak_tags else 'РЅРµРёР·РІРµСЃС‚РЅС‹'}.

РЈСЂРѕРє СЃРѕРґРµСЂР¶РёС‚ СЃР»РµРґСѓСЋС‰РµРµ РїСЂР°РІРёР»Рѕ:
{lesson.content.get('rule', '')}

РџСЂРёРјРµСЂС‹ РёР· СѓСЂРѕРєР°:
{lesson.content.get('examples', [])}

Р¤РѕСЂРјР°С‚ РѕС‚РІРµС‚Р° вЂ” JSON-РјР°СЃСЃРёРІ СЃ РѕР±СЉРµРєС‚Р°РјРё:
[
  {{
    "type": "fill",  // РІРѕР·РјРѕР¶РЅС‹Рµ С‚РёРїС‹: fill, choose, match, translate
    "question": "С‚РµРєСЃС‚ РІРѕРїСЂРѕСЃР°",
    "answer": "РїСЂР°РІРёР»СЊРЅС‹Р№ РѕС‚РІРµС‚",
    "hint": "РїРѕРґСЃРєР°Р·РєР° (РѕРїС†РёРѕРЅР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ)"
  }}
]

РЎРґРµР»Р°Р№ СѓРїСЂР°Р¶РЅРµРЅРёСЏ СЂР°Р·РЅРѕРіРѕ С‚РёРїР° Рё СѓСЂРѕРІРЅСЏ СЃР»РѕР¶РЅРѕСЃС‚Рё, СЃРѕРѕС‚РІРµС‚СЃС‚РІСѓСЋС‰РёРµ СѓСЂРѕРІРЅСЋ СѓС‡РµРЅРёРєР° Рё РµРіРѕ СЃР»Р°Р±РѕСЃС‚СЏРј.
"""
    
    # 4. Р—Р°РїСЂР°С€РёРІР°РµРј OpenAI
    response = openai.ChatCompletion.create(
        model=settings.OPENAI_MODEL,
        messages=[
            {"role": "system", "content": "РўС‹ вЂ” РіРµРЅРµСЂР°С‚РѕСЂ СѓРїСЂР°Р¶РЅРµРЅРёР№ РїРѕ РЅРµРјРµС†РєРѕРјСѓ СЏР·С‹РєСѓ. РћС‚РІРµС‡Р°Р№ С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ JSON."},
            {"role": "user", "content": prompt}
        ],
        temperature=0.7,
        max_tokens=600
    )
    
    # 5. РџР°СЂСЃРёРј РѕС‚РІРµС‚
    try:
        exercises = json.loads(response.choices[0].message.content)
        return exercises
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        # Р—Р°РїР°СЃРЅРѕР№ РІР°СЂРёР°РЅС‚, РµСЃР»Рё JSON РЅРµРІР°Р»РёРґРЅС‹Р№
        return [
            {"type": "fill", "question": "Р’СЃС‚Р°РІСЊС‚Рµ РїСЂРѕРїСѓС‰РµРЅРЅРѕРµ СЃР»РѕРІРѕ", "answer": "РїСЂРёРјРµСЂ", "hint": "РџРѕРґСЃРєР°Р·РєР°"}
        ]

def generate_plan(db: Session, user_id: int, limit: int = 15):
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id).first()
    if not user:
        return []
    
    diag = db.query(DiagnosticResult).filter(
        DiagnosticResult.user_id == user_id
    ).order_by(DiagnosticResult.created_at.desc()).first()
    
    if not diag or not diag.weak_points:
        return []

    weak_tags = list(diag.weak_points.keys())
    
    lessons = db.query(Lesson).filter(
        Lesson.level == user.current_level,
        Lesson.weak_point_tags.op('&&')(weak_tags),
        Lesson.is_active == True
    ).all()
    
    def priority(lesson):
        return sum(diag.weak_points.get(tag, 0) for tag in lesson.weak_point_tags)
    
    lessons.sort(key=priority, reverse=True)
    
    completed_ids = [
        p[0] for p in db.query(UserProgress.lesson_id)
        .filter(UserProgress.user_id == user_id, UserProgress.completed == True)
        .all()
    ]
    filtered = [l for l in lessons if l.id not in completed_ids]
    
    return filtered[:limit]

# backend/app/services/srs.py
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.models.progress import UserProgress

def schedule_review(db: Session, user_id: int, lesson_id: int):
    progress = db.query(UserProgress).filter(
        UserProgress.user_id == user_id,
        UserProgress.lesson_id == lesson_id
    ).first()
    if progress:
        intervals = [1, 3, 7, 14, 30]
        now = datetime.now()
        progress.review_dates = [(now + timedelta(days=d)) for d in intervals]
        db.commit()

# backend/app/services/tutor.py
import openai
from app.core.config import settings
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from app.models.user import User

openai.api_key = settings.OPENAI_API_KEY

def ask_tutor(db: Session, user_id: int, question: str) -> str:
    user = db.query(User).filter(User.id == user_id).first()
    level = user.current_level if user else 'A1'

    system_prompt = f"""
РўС‹ вЂ” DeutschIQ Р РµРїРµС‚РёС‚РѕСЂ, СЌРєСЃРїРµСЂС‚ РїРѕ РЅРµРјРµС†РєРѕРјСѓ СЏР·С‹РєСѓ (СѓСЂРѕРІРµРЅСЊ C2).
РћС‚РІРµС‡Р°Р№ РІСЃРµРіРґР° РЅР° СЂСѓСЃСЃРєРѕРј СЏР·С‹РєРµ. РЈСЂРѕРІРµРЅСЊ РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЏ: {level}.

РџСЂР°РІРёР»Р°:
- Р”Р»СЏ РіСЂР°РјРјР°С‚РёРєРё: РґР°Р№ РїСЂР°РІРёР»Рѕ (РјР°РєСЃРёРјСѓРј 3 РїСЂРµРґР»РѕР¶РµРЅРёСЏ), 3 РїСЂРёРјРµСЂР°, РїРѕРїСЂРѕСЃРё РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЏ СЃРѕСЃС‚Р°РІРёС‚СЊ СЃРІРѕР№ РїСЂРёРјРµСЂ.
- Р”Р»СЏ Р»РµРєСЃРёРєРё: РґР°Р№ РїРµСЂРµРІРѕРґ, 2 РєРѕРЅС‚РµРєСЃС‚Р°, РїСЂРµРґР»РѕР¶РµРЅРёРµ.
- РќРёРєРѕРіРґР° РЅРµ РІС‹РґСѓРјС‹РІР°Р№ СЃР»РѕРІР°. Р•СЃР»Рё РЅРµ СѓРІРµСЂРµРЅ, СЃРєР°Р¶Рё: "РЇ РЅРµ СѓРІРµСЂРµРЅ, РґР°РІР°Р№ РїСЂРѕРІРµСЂРёРј РІРјРµСЃС‚Рµ".
- Р‘СѓРґСЊ РґРѕР±СЂРѕР¶РµР»Р°С‚РµР»СЊРЅС‹Рј Рё РёСЃРїРѕР»СЊР·СѓР№ СЌРјРѕРґР·Рё.
"""
    response = openai.ChatCompletion.create(
        model=settings.OPENAI_MODEL,
        messages=[
            {"role": "system", "content": system_prompt},
            {"role": "user", "content": question}
        ],
        temperature=0.7,
        max_tokens=500
    )
    return response.choices[0].message.content

# React + TypeScript + Vite

This template provides a minimal setup to get React working in Vite with HMR and some Oxlint rules.

Currently, two official plugins are available:

- [@vitejs/plugin-react](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react) uses [Oxc](https://oxc.rs)
- [@vitejs/plugin-react-swc](https://github.com/vitejs/vite-plugin-react/blob/main/packages/plugin-react-swc) uses [SWC](https://swc.rs/)

## React Compiler

The React Compiler is not enabled on this template because of its impact on dev & build performances. To add it, see [this documentation](https://react.dev/learn/react-compiler/installation).

## Expanding the Oxlint configuration

If you are developing a production application, we recommend enabling type-aware lint rules by installing `oxlint-tsgolint` and editing `.oxlintrc.json`:

```json
{
  "$schema": "./node_modules/oxlint/configuration_schema.json",
  "plugins": ["react", "typescript", "oxc"],
  "options": {
    "typeAware": true
  },
  "rules": {
    "react/rules-of-hooks": "error",
    "react/only-export-components": ["warn", { "allowConstantExport": true }]
  }
}
```

See the [Oxlint rules documentation](https://oxc.rs/docs/guide/usage/linter/rules) for the full list of rules and categories.

import React from 'react';
import { useNavigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { FaHome, FaChartLine, FaCalendarAlt, FaRobot, FaUser } from 'react-icons/fa';
import { useLanguage } from '../context/LanguageContext';
import { getText } from '../i18n/translations';

export const BottomNav: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { lang } = useLanguage();
  const t = getText(lang);

  const tabs = [
    { key: '/dashboard', icon: FaHome, label: t.nav.overview },
    { key: '/analytics', icon: FaChartLine, label: t.nav.analysis },
    { key: '/plan', icon: FaCalendarAlt, label: t.nav.plan },
    { key: '/tutor', icon: FaRobot, label: t.nav.tutor },
    { key: '/profile', icon: FaUser, label: t.nav.profile },
  ];

  const userId = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('user_id') || '123456';

  const navigateTo = (path: string) => {
    navigate(`${path}?user_id=${userId}`);
  };

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: 'fixed',
      bottom: 0,
      left: 0,
      right: 0,
      background: 'rgba(11, 17, 32, 0.92)',
      backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
      borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04)',
      display: 'flex',
      justifyContent: 'space-around',
      padding: '10px 0 16px 0',
      zIndex: 100,
    }}>
      {tabs.map((tab) => {
        const isActive = location.pathname === tab.key;
        const Icon = tab.icon;
        return (
          <button
            key={tab.key}
            onClick={() => navigateTo(tab.key)}

              background: 'transparent',

              alignItems: 'center',

            />

              <div style={{
                position: 'absolute',

// frontend/mini-app/src/components/Card.tsx
import React from 'react';

interface CardProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  gold?: boolean;
  hover?: boolean;
  onClick?: () => void;
  style?: React.CSSProperties;
}

export const Card: React.FC<CardProps> = ({ 
  children, 
  className = '', 
  gold = false, 
  hover = true, 
  onClick,
  style 
}) => {
  const baseClass = gold ? 'glass-card-gold' : 'glass-card';
  const hoverClass = hover ? 'card-hover' : '';
  
  return (
    <div 
      className={`${baseClass} ${hoverClass} ${className}`}
      onClick={onClick}
      style={style}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
};

// frontend/mini-app/src/components/CircularGauge.tsx
import React from 'react';

interface CircularGaugeProps {
  level: string;
  percentage: string;
  size?: number;
}

export const CircularGauge: React.FC<CircularGaugeProps> = ({ level, percentage, size = 140 }) => {
  const radius = 55;
  const strokeWidth = 8;
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  const progress = parseInt(percentage) / 100;
  const dashOffset = circumference * (1 - progress);

  return (
    <div style={{ width: size, height: size, position: 'relative' }}>
      <svg width={size} height={size} viewBox="0 0 140 140">
        <circle cx="70" cy="70" r={radius} fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.05)" strokeWidth={strokeWidth} />
        <circle cx="70" cy="70" r={radius} fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinecap="round" strokeDasharray={circumference} strokeDashoffset={dashOffset} transform="rotate(-90 70 70)" style={{ transition: 'stroke-dashoffset 1s ease-in-out' }} />
        <circle cx="70" cy="70" r={radius} fill="none" stroke="#FFD700" strokeWidth={2} strokeLinecap="round" strokeDasharray={circumference} strokeDashoffset={dashOffset} transform="rotate(-90 70 70)" opacity="0.3" filter="blur(6px)" />
        <text x="70" y="62" textAnchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" fontSize="22" fontWeight="bold">{level}</text>
        <text x="70" y="88" textAnchor="middle" fill="#FFD700" fontSize="16" fontWeight="600">{percentage}</text>
      </svg>
    </div>
  );
};

// frontend/mini-app/src/components/LevelWheel.tsx
import React, { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

interface LevelWheelProps {
  level: string;
  percentage: number;
  size?: number;
}

export const LevelWheel: React.FC<LevelWheelProps> = ({ level, percentage, size = 140 }) => {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
  const rotationRef = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return;

    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = size * dpr;
    canvas.height = size * dpr;
    canvas.style.width = `${size}px`;
    canvas.style.height = `${size}px`;
    ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

    const radius = size / 2 - 16;
    const centerX = size / 2;
    const centerY = size / 2;

    let animationId: number;

    const draw = () => {
      rotationRef.current += 0.008;
      const rot = rotationRef.current;

      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size);

      // Р¤РѕРЅРѕРІС‹Р№ РєСЂСѓРі
      const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(centerX, centerY, 0, centerX, centerY, radius);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.05)');
      gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.01)');
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
      ctx.fill();

      // РћСЃРЅРѕРІРЅР°СЏ РґСѓРіР° (РїСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃСЃ)
      const startAngle = -Math.PI / 2 + rot;
      const endAngle = startAngle + (percentage / 100) * Math.PI * 2;

      // РўРµРЅСЊ
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.3)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 20;

      const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, size, size);
      grad.addColorStop(0, '#FBBF24');
      grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#FCD34D');
      grad.addColorStop(1, '#F59E0B');
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, radius - 4, startAngle, endAngle);
      ctx.strokeStyle = grad;
      ctx.lineWidth = 10;
      ctx.lineCap = 'round';
      ctx.stroke();

      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

      // Р’СЂР°С‰Р°СЋС‰РёРµСЃСЏ С‚РѕС‡РєРё РЅР° РґСѓРіРµ (СЌС„С„РµРєС‚ В«РєРѕР»РµСЃР°В»)
      const dotCount = 12;
      for (let i = 0; i < dotCount; i++) {
        const angle = startAngle + (i / dotCount) * (endAngle - startAngle);
        const x = centerX + (radius - 14) * Math.cos(angle);
        const y = centerY + (radius - 14) * Math.sin(angle);
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(x, y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 === 0 ? 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.6)' : 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.2)';
        ctx.fill();
      }

      // РўРµРєСЃС‚ СѓСЂРѕРІРЅСЏ РІ С†РµРЅС‚СЂРµ
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.2)';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 30;
      ctx.textAlign = 'center';
      ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
      ctx.font = `bold ${size * 0.22}px Inter, sans-serif`;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
      ctx.fillText(level, centerX, centerY - 10);

      ctx.font = `${size * 0.11}px Inter, sans-serif`;
      ctx.fillStyle = '#FBBF24';
      ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
      ctx.fillText(`${Math.round(percentage)}%`, centerX, centerY + 26);

      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

      animationId = requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    };

    draw();

    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
    };
  }, [percentage, level, size]);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        display: 'block',
      }}
    />
  );
};

import React from 'react';
import { Radar } from 'react-chartjs-2';
import {
  Chart as ChartJS,
  RadialLinearScale,
  PointElement,
  LineElement,
  Filler,
  Tooltip,
  Legend,
} from 'chart.js';

ChartJS.register(RadialLinearScale, PointElement, LineElement, Filler, Tooltip, Legend);

interface RadarChartProps {
  data: {
    labels: string[];
    values: number[];
  };
  maxValue?: number;
  label?: string;
}

export const RadarChart: React.FC<RadarChartProps> = ({
  data,
  maxValue = 10,
  label = 'РћС†РµРЅРєР°',
}) => {
  const chartData = {
    labels: data.labels,
    datasets: [
      {
        label: label,
        data: data.values,
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.15)',
        borderColor: '#FBBF24',
        borderWidth: 2,
        pointBackgroundColor: '#FBBF24',
        pointBorderColor: '#FFFFFF',
        pointHoverBackgroundColor: '#FFFFFF',
        pointHoverBorderColor: '#FBBF24',
      },
    ],
  };

  const options = {
    scales: {
      r: {
        beginAtZero: true,
        max: maxValue,
        ticks: {
          stepSize: 2,
          color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)',
          backdropColor: 'transparent',
        },
        grid: {
          color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)',
        },
        angleLines: {
          color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)',
        },
        pointLabels: {
          color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)',
          font: {
            size: 11,
            weight: '500' as any,
          },
        },
      },
    },
    plugins: {
      legend: {
        display: false,
      },
      tooltip: {
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(11, 17, 32, 0.9)',
        titleColor: '#FFFFFF',
        bodyColor: '#FBBF24',
        borderColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.06)',
        borderWidth: 1,
      },
    },
    maintainAspectRatio: false,
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ width: '100%', height: '220px', position: 'relative' }}>
      <Radar data={chartData} options={options} />
    </div>
  );
};

        </span>
        <span style={{ color, fontSize: '16px', fontWeight: '700' }}>
          {numericValue.toFixed(1)} {arrow}
        </span>
      </div>
      <svg width="100%" height="20" viewBox="0 0 50 14" style={{ marginTop: '6px' }}>
        <polyline
          points={points}
          fill="none"
          stroke={color}
          strokeWidth="2"
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          filter={trend === 'up' ? 'drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(255,215,0,0.3))' : 'none'}
        />
        <polyline
          points={points}
          fill="none"
          stroke={color}
          strokeWidth="4"
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          opacity="0.15"
        />
      </svg>
    </div>
  );
};

// frontend/mini-app/src/components/WeaknessItem.tsx
import React from 'react';

export const WeaknessItem: React.FC<{ name: string; percent: number }> = ({ name, percent }) => {
  const color = percent > 30 ? '#E3000F' : percent > 20 ? '#FF8C00' : '#FFD700';
  const glow = percent > 30 ? '0 0 12px rgba(227,0,15,0.15)' : '0 0 12px rgba(255,140,0,0.1)';
  return (
    <div style={{ marginBottom: '12px', padding: '14px 16px', background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', borderRadius: '12px', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' }}>
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', marginBottom: '6px' }}>
        <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)', fontSize: '14px', fontWeight: '500' }}>{name}</span>
        <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)', fontSize: '13px', fontWeight: '600' }}>{percent}%</span>
      </div>
      <div className="progress-bar" style={{ height: '4px' }}>
        <div className="progress-bar-fill" style={{ width: `${percent}%`, background: color, boxShadow: glow }} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

// frontend/mini-app/src/context/LanguageContext.tsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState } from 'react';

type Language = 'de' | 'ru';

interface LanguageContextType {
  lang: Language;
  toggleLang: () => void;
}

const LanguageContext = createContext<LanguageContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const LanguageProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [lang, setLang] = useState<Language>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('deutschiq_lang') as Language;
    return saved || 'de';
  });

  const toggleLang = () => {
    const newLang = lang === 'de' ? 'ru' : 'de';
    setLang(newLang);
    localStorage.setItem('deutschiq_lang', newLang);
  };

  return (
    <LanguageContext.Provider value={{ lang, toggleLang }}>
      {children}
    </LanguageContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useLanguage = () => {
  const context = useContext(LanguageContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error('useLanguage must be used within LanguageProvider');
  return context;
};

FILE: C:\Users\Даша\DeutschIQ\frontend\mini-app\src\context\ThemeContext.tsx
==============================

import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';

type Theme = 'dark' | 'light';

interface ThemeContextType {
  theme: Theme;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
}

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export const ThemeProvider: React.FC<{ children: React.ReactNode }> = ({ children }) => {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<Theme>(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('deutschiq_theme') as Theme;
    return saved || 'dark';
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', theme);
    localStorage.setItem('deutschiq_theme', theme);
  }, [theme]);

  const toggleTheme = () => {
    setTheme(prev => (prev === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'));
  };

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, toggleTheme }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useTheme = () => {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) throw new Error('useTheme must be used within ThemeProvider');
  return context;
};

// frontend/mini-app/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useLanguage } from '../context/LanguageContext';
import { getText } from '../i18n/translations';
import { LevelWheel } from '../components/LevelWheel';
import { BottomNav } from '../components/BottomNav';
import { api } from '../services/api';

// РњР°СЃСЃРёРІ РёРєРѕРЅРѕРє РґР»СЏ РІСЂР°РіРѕРІ
const enemyIcons = ['рџ”„', 'рџЋЇ', 'рџ“¦'];

export const Dashboard: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { lang, toggleLang } = useLanguage();
  const t = getText(lang);
  const [data, setData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [userId, setUserId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [counter, setCounter] = useState(234);

  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const id = params.get('user_id');
    if (id) setUserId(Number(id));
    else {
      const tg = (window as any).Telegram?.WebApp;
      if (tg?.initDataUnsafe?.user) {
        setUserId(tg.initDataUnsafe.user.id);
      } else {
        setUserId(123456);
      }
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  // Р¤РµР№РєРѕРІРѕРµ РѕР±РЅРѕРІР»РµРЅРёРµ СЃС‡С‘С‚С‡РёРєР°
  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      setCounter(prev => prev + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3));
    }, 5000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (userId === null) return;
    api.getDashboard(userId)
      .then(res => {
        const safeData = {
          ...res,
          stats: Array.isArray(res?.stats) ? res.stats : [],
          weaknesses: Array.isArray(res?.weaknesses) ? res.weaknesses : [],
          level: res?.level || 'A1',
          percentage: res?.percentage || 0,
          targetLevel: res?.targetLevel || 'B2',
          targetProgress: res?.targetProgress || 0,
        };
        if (safeData.weaknesses.length === 0) safeData.weaknesses = t.dashboard.weaknesses.items;
        if (safeData.stats.length === 0) safeData.stats = t.dashboard.stats;
        setData(safeData);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        setData({
          level: 'A1',
          percentage: 0,
          targetLevel: 'B2',
          targetProgress: 0,
          stats: t.dashboard.stats,
          weaknesses: t.dashboard.weaknesses.items,
        });
      });
  }, [userId, lang]);

  if (loading || userId === null) {
    return (
      <div style={{ padding: '20px', minHeight: '100vh', background: 'linear-gradient(145deg, #0B1120, #080C14)' }}>
        <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: '40px', width: '60%', marginBottom: '20px' }} />
        <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: '140px', borderRadius: '20px', marginBottom: '16px' }} />
        <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: '80px', borderRadius: '20px', marginBottom: '16px' }} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const d = data || { level: 'A1', percentage: 0, targetLevel: 'B2', targetProgress: 0, stats: t.dashboard.stats, weaknesses: t.dashboard.weaknesses.items };
  const weaknesses = Array.isArray(d.weaknesses) ? d.weaknesses : [];
  const levelDisplay = d.level ? `${d.level}+` : 'A1';
  const hasData = d.percentage > 0;

  // РўРѕРї-3 СЃР»Р°Р±С‹С… РјРµСЃС‚Р° РґР»СЏ РєР°СЂС‚РѕС‡РµРє
  const topWeaknesses = weaknesses.slice(0, 3).map((w: any, idx: number) => ({
    name: w.name,
    percent: Math.round(w.percent || 50 + idx * 10),
    icon: enemyIcons[idx % enemyIcons.length],
  }));

  return (
    <div className="fade-up" style={{ padding: '20px 20px 100px 20px', minHeight: '100vh', background: 'linear-gradient(145deg, #0B1120, #080C14)' }}>
      
      {/* РЁРђРџРљРђ */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', marginBottom: '8px' }}>
        <div>
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '18px', fontWeight: '700', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
              {lang === 'de' ? 'Hallo' : 'РџСЂРёРІРµС‚'} рџ‘‹
            </span>
          </div>
          <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontSize: '13px', margin: '2px 0 0 0' }}>
            {hasData 
              ? (lang === 'de' ? 'Du bist auf dem richtigen Weg!' : 'РўС‹ РЅР° РІРµСЂРЅРѕРј РїСѓС‚Рё!')
              : (lang === 'de' ? 'Starte deine Reise!' : 'РќР°С‡РЅРё СЃРІРѕС‘ РїСѓС‚РµС€РµСЃС‚РІРёРµ!')
            }
          </p>
        </div>
        <button onClick={toggleLang} style={{ padding: '6px 14px', background: 'rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.1)', border: '1px solid rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.2)', borderRadius: '24px', color: '#FBBF24', fontSize: '12px', fontWeight: '600', cursor: 'pointer' }}>

        <div style={{ flex: 1 }}>

// frontend/mini-app/src/pages/Diagnostic.tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useLanguage } from '../context/LanguageContext';
import { getText } from '../i18n/translations';
import { api } from '../services/api';

export const Diagnostic: React.FC = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { lang } = useLanguage();
  const t = getText(lang);
  const [questions, setQuestions] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(0);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [userId, setUserId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<{ text: string; isCorrect: boolean } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const id = params.get('user_id');
    setUserId(id ? Number(id) : 123456);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (userId === null) return;
    api.getQuestions('ru')
      .then(data => { setQuestions(data); setLoading(false); })
      .catch(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [userId]);

  const handleSelect = (option: string) => {
    const q = questions[current];
    const isCorrect = option === q.correct_answer;
    setAnswers({ ...answers, [q.id]: option });
    setFeedback({ text: q.explanation || (isCorrect ? 'вњ… РџСЂР°РІРёР»СЊРЅРѕ!' : 'вќЊ РќРµРїСЂР°РІРёР»СЊРЅРѕ. РџРѕРїСЂРѕР±СѓР№ РµС‰С‘ СЂР°Р·'), isCorrect });
    setTimeout(() => setFeedback(null), 1500);
    if (current < questions.length - 1) {
      setTimeout(() => setCurrent(current + 1), 1200);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!userId) return;
    try {
      await api.submitDiagnostic({ user_id: userId, answers });
      navigate(`/?user_id=${userId}`);
    } catch (error) { console.error(error); }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{ padding: '20px', minHeight: '100vh', background: 'linear-gradient(145deg, #0B1120, #080C14)' }}>
        <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: '40px', width: '60%', marginBottom: '20px' }} />
        <div className="skeleton" style={{ height: '120px', borderRadius: '20px' }} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (questions.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div style={{ padding: '20px', minHeight: '100vh', background: 'linear-gradient(145deg, #0B1120, #080C14)', color: 'var(--text-primary)' }}>
        <p>{t.diagnostic.noQuestions}</p>
        <button onClick={() => navigate('/')} className="btn-gold" style={{ marginTop: '16px' }}>РќР°Р·Р°Рґ</button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const q = questions[current];
  const progress = ((current) / questions.length) * 100;

  return (
    <div className="fade-up" style={{ padding: '20px', paddingBottom: '100px', minHeight: '100vh', background: 'linear-gradient(145deg, #0B1120, #080C14)' }}>
      <h2 style={{ color: 'var(--text-primary)', fontSize: '20px', fontWeight: '600', marginBottom: '4px' }}>{t.diagnostic.title}</h2>
      <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', fontSize: '14px', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
        {t.diagnostic.question.replace('{current}', String(current + 1)).replace('{total}', String(questions.length))}
      </p>
      <div className="progress-bar" style={{ marginBottom: '24px', height: '6px' }}>
        <div className="progress-bar-fill" style={{ width: `${progress}%` }} />
      </div>

      <div className="glass-card" style={{ padding: '24px 20px' }}>
        <p style={{ fontSize: '20px', fontWeight: '500', color: 'var(--text-primary)', marginBottom: '24px', lineHeight: '1.5' }}>{q.text}</p>
        <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px' }}>
          {q.options.map((opt: string) => (
            <button
              key={opt}
              onClick={() => handleSelect(opt)}
              className="btn-gold"
              style={{ width: '100%', textAlign: 'left', padding: '14px 20px', fontWeight: '500' }}
            >
              {opt}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        {feedback && (
          <div style={{ marginTop: '12px', padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: '8px', background: feedback.isCorrect ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.08)', border: `1px solid ${feedback.isCorrect ? 'rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.15)' : 'rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15)'}` }}>
            <p style={{ color: feedback.isCorrect ? '#10B981' : '#EF4444', fontSize: '14px', margin: 0 }}>
              {feedback.text}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {current === questions.length - 1 && (
        <button onClick={handleSubmit} className="btn-primary" style={{ marginTop: '24px', width: '100%' }}>
          {t.diagnostic.finish}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useLanguage } from '../context/LanguageContext';
import { useTheme } from '../context/ThemeContext';
import { getText } from '../i18n/translations';
import { BottomNav } from '../components/BottomNav';
import { api } from '../services/api';

export const Profile: React.FC = () => {
  const { lang, toggleLang } = useLanguage();
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();
  const t = getText(lang);
  const [userData, setUserData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [userId, setUserId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    setUserId(params.get('user_id') ? Number(params.get('user_id')) : 123456);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (userId === null) return;
    api.getDashboard(userId)
      .then((dashboardData) => {
        setUserData(dashboardData);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [userId]);

  const handleUpgrade = () => {
    const tg = (window as any).Telegram?.WebApp;
    if (tg) tg.sendData(JSON.stringify({ command: '/subscribe' }));
    else window.open('https://t.me/DeutschIQ_bot?start=subscribe', '_blank');
  };

  const handleReferral = () => {
    const link = `https://t.me/DeutschIQ_bot?start=ref_${userId}`;
    navigator.clipboard?.writeText(link);
    alert(lang === 'de' ? 'Link kopiert! вњ…' : 'РЎСЃС‹Р»РєР° СЃРєРѕРїРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅР°! вњ…');

  const nextLevelProgress = 63;

  const allBadges = [
    { id: 'first_test', name: lang === 'de' ? 'Erster Test' : 'РџРµСЂРІС‹Р№ С‚РµСЃС‚', icon: 'рџЏ…', earned: true },
    { id: 'week_streak', name: lang === 'de' ? 'Woche dran' : 'РќРµРґРµР»СЏ СѓСЃРёР»РёР№', icon: 'рџ”Ґ', earned: streak >= 7 },

  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);

// frontend/mini-app/src/pages/Tutor.tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { BottomNav } from '../components/BottomNav';
import { useLanguage } from '../context/LanguageContext';
import { getText } from '../i18n/translations';
import { api } from '../services/api';

interface Message { id: string; text: string; sender: 'user' | 'bot'; timestamp: Date; }

export const Tutor: React.FC = () => {
  const { lang } = useLanguage();
  const t = getText(lang);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>([
    { id: '1', text: lang === 'de' ? 'рџ‘‹ Hallo! Wie kann ich dir helfen?' : 'рџ‘‹ РџСЂРёРІРµС‚! Р§РµРј РјРѕРіСѓ РїРѕРјРѕС‡СЊ?', sender: 'bot', timestamp: new Date() },
  ]);
  const [input, setInput] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [userId, setUserId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    setUserId(params.get('user_id') ? Number(params.get('user_id')) : 123456);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => { messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }); }, [messages]);

  const sendMessage = async () => {
    if (!input.trim() || !userId) return;
    const userMsg: Message = { id: Date.now().toString(), text: input, sender: 'user', timestamp: new Date() };
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setInput('');
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await api.askTutor({ user_id: userId, question: input });
      const botMsg: Message = { id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(), text: res.answer || 'рџ¤” РќРµ РїРѕРЅСЏР».', sender: 'bot', timestamp: new Date() };
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, botMsg]);
    } catch {
      const errMsg: Message = { id: (Date.now() + 1).toString(), text: lang === 'de' ? 'вљ пёЏ Fehler.' : 'вљ пёЏ РћС€РёР±РєР°.', sender: 'bot', timestamp: new Date() };
      setMessages(prev => [...prev, errMsg]);
    } finally { setLoading(false); }
  };

  const handleKey = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) { e.preventDefault(); sendMessage(); } };

  // Р‘С‹СЃС‚СЂС‹Рµ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё
  const quickButtons = lang === 'de'
    ? ['ErklГ¤re den Dativ', 'Konjugation von sein', 'Gib mir eine Гњbung']
    : ['РћР±СЉСЏСЃРЅРё РґР°С‚РµР»СЊРЅС‹Р№ РїР°РґРµР¶', 'РЎРїСЂСЏР¶РµРЅРёРµ sein', 'Р”Р°Р№ СѓРїСЂР°Р¶РЅРµРЅРёРµ'];

  return (
    <div className="fade-up" style={{ padding: '20px 20px 100px 20px', minHeight: '100vh', background: 'linear-gradient(145deg, #0B1120, #080C14)' }}>
      <h1 style={{ fontSize: '24px', fontWeight: '700', background: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #FBBF24, #FCD34D)', WebkitBackgroundClip: 'text', WebkitTextFillColor: 'transparent' }}>{t.tutor.title}</h1>
      <p style={{ color: 'var(--text-secondary)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>{t.tutor.subtitle}</p>

      <div className="glass-card" style={{ padding: '16px', minHeight: '420px', maxHeight: '540px', overflowY: 'auto', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px', marginBottom: '16px' }}>
        {messages.map((msg) => (
          <div key={msg.id} className="slide-in" style={{ alignSelf: msg.sender === 'user' ? 'flex-end' : 'flex-start', maxWidth: '80%' }}>
            <div style={{ padding: '12px 16px', borderRadius: '16px', background: msg.sender === 'user' ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, #FBBF24, #FCD34D)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)', color: msg.sender === 'user' ? '#0B1120' : 'var(--text-primary)', border: msg.sender === 'bot' ? '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' : 'none', borderBottomRightRadius: msg.sender === 'user' ? '4px' : '16px', borderBottomLeftRadius: msg.sender === 'bot' ? '4px' : '16px' }}>
              <p style={{ margin: 0, fontSize: '15px', lineHeight: '1.5' }}>{msg.text}</p>
            </div>
            <p style={{ margin: '4px 8px 0', fontSize: '10px', color: 'var(--text-muted)', textAlign: msg.sender === 'user' ? 'right' : 'left' }}>
              {msg.timestamp.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' })}
            </p>
          </div>
        ))}
        {loading && <div style={{ alignSelf: 'flex-start', padding: '12px 16px', background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)', borderRadius: '16px', border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' }}><span style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>...</span></div>}
        <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
      </div>

      {/* Р‘С‹СЃС‚СЂС‹Рµ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё */}
      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '8px', flexWrap: 'wrap', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
        {quickButtons.map((text) => (
          <button
            key={text}
            onClick={() => setInput(text)}
            className="btn-gold"
            style={{ padding: '6px 14px', fontSize: '12px' }}
          >
            {text}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: '10px', alignItems: 'flex-end' }}>
        <textarea
          value={input}
          onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={handleKey}
          placeholder={t.tutor.placeholder}
          rows={2}
          className="input-gold"
          style={{ flex: 1, fontFamily: 'inherit', resize: 'none', minHeight: '48px' }}
        />
        <button onClick={sendMessage} disabled={loading || !input.trim()} className="btn-primary" style={{ padding: '12px 20px', minHeight: '48px', borderRadius: '12px', fontSize: '16px', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', opacity: loading || !input.trim() ? 0.5 : 1 }}>
          {loading ? '...' : 'вћ¤'}
        </button>
      </div>

      <BottomNav />
    </div>
  );
};

import axios from 'axios';

const API_BASE = '';

console.log('рџ”Ќ API_BASE =', API_BASE);

const apiClient = axios.create({
  baseURL: API_BASE,
  timeout: 30000,
});

apiClient.interceptors.response.use(
  response => response,
  error => {
    console.error('вќЊ API Error:', error.response?.data || error.message);
    return Promise.reject(error);
  }
);

export const api = {
  // Р”РёР°РіРЅРѕСЃС‚РёРєР°
  getQuestions: (lang: string = 'ru') => {
    return apiClient.get(`/api/diagnostic/questions?lang=${lang}`).then(r => r.data);
  },
  submitDiagnostic: (payload: { user_id: number; answers: Record<number, string> }) => {
    return apiClient.post('/api/diagnostic/submit', payload).then(r => r.data);
  },

  // Dashboard
  getDashboard: (userId: number) => {
    return apiClient.get(`/api/dashboard/${userId}`).then(r => r.data);
  },

  // РћС€РёР±РєРё
  getMistakes: (userId: number) => {
    return apiClient.get(`/api/mistakes/${userId}`).then(r => r.data);
  },

  // РџР»Р°РЅ
  getPlan: (userId: number) => {
    return apiClient.get(`/api/plan/${userId}`).then(r => r.data);
  },

  // РЈСЂРѕРєРё
  getLesson: (lessonId: number) => {
    return apiClient.get(`/api/lesson/${lessonId}`).then(r => r.data);
  },
  generateExercises: (payload: { user_id: number; lesson_id: number }) => {
    return apiClient.post('/api/lesson/generate-exercises', payload).then(r => r.data);
  },
  completeLesson: (payload: { user_id: number; lesson_id: number }) => {
    return apiClient.post('/api/lesson/complete', payload).then(r => r.data);
  },

  // AI-С‚СЊСЋС‚РѕСЂ
  askTutor: (payload: { user_id: number; question: string; history?: any[] }) => {
    return apiClient.post('/api/tutor/ask', payload).then(r => r.data);
  },

  // Р”РѕСЃС‚РёР¶РµРЅРёСЏ
  getBadges: (userId: number) => {
    return apiClient.get(`/api/badges/${userId}`).then(r => r.data);
  },

  // РЎС‚Р°С‚РёСЃС‚РёРєР°
  getStats: (userId: number) => {
    return apiClient.get(`/api/stats/${userId}`).then(r => r.data);
  },

  // Р РµС„РµСЂР°Р»С‹
  createReferral: (userId: number) => {
    return apiClient.post('/api/referral/create', { user_id: userId }).then(r => r.data);
  },
  claimReferral: (referrerId: number, refereeId: number) => {
    return apiClient.post('/api/referral/claim', { referrer_id: referrerId, referee_id: refereeId }).then(r => r.data);
  },
};
